name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/quartz-mdx
description: Quartz 5 page type for .mdx pages, with widgets as islands. See CONTEXT.md and docs/adr/.
//exports: Every entry has its type declarations beside it, which build.mjs emits: Quartz's generated plugin index skips a package without dist/index.d.ts, and a TypeScript site imports the types from them. ./package.json is how Quartz reads the manifest (import.meta.resolve).
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copies, never bundled or installed here: two Preacts break hydration, and a page type's markup must be the host's vnodes. unified and vfile are the ones the pipeline library, which this plugin inlines, runs the site's transformers with (#98).
//dependencies: esbuild bundles widgets at site-build time, so it stays a runtime dependency; it is native and cannot be inlined.
//devDependencies: Inlined into dist by build.mjs. Our libraries are `workspace:*` specs, which `pnpm publish` rewrites to the published version (ADR-0005). The remark and hast packages are bundled, since nothing in them depends on instance identity. unified and vfile, which Quartz shares with its plugins, are peers instead, never installed here (#98). @chaoticgoodcomputing/declarations writes the .d.ts beside each entry (build.mjs).
